name: Konna Watashi o Yurushite
source:
Lately the protagonist's wife Kanako has not been herself so he asks his childhood friend Misaki who is a detective to spy on her.
Turns out she is having an affair!
The protagonist cannot believe this. What will he do?

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038174.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
最近主人公的妻子加奈子有些不对劲，于是他请当侦探的青梅竹马美咲去监视她。结果发现她有外遇！主人公不敢相信。他该怎么办？
